squad.title: See your squad
squad.hint: Meet your players, their ratings and their fitness.

lineup.title: Pick your line-up
lineup.hint: Your assistant already picks your eleven: choose your formation, or pick it yourself.

tips.rating: A rating, from 1 to 99, sums up a player's current level. Potential (Pot.) is the estimated ceiling they can reach.
tips.secondary: The small outlined badges are a player's secondary positions: they play there at {percent}% of their rating, and less well elsewhere.
tips.money: The transfer budget pays for signings and a free agent's signing bonus. Your squad has 30 players at most.
tips.simulation: “{button}” plays several matchdays in one go, with no live match, and gives you the summary.
